svg.title: se-dev-mes: how the skill is built, by the numbers
svg.desc: Infographic of the se-dev-mes Space Engineers MES/RivalAI skill. Measured 2026-09-24 at commit 89443e8.
svg.text: A Space Engineers MES & RivalAI skill for AI coding agents: how it is built, by the numbers

g.text: Solid: counted from the repo files

svg.text: The local MES install, parsed tag by tag
Re-reads the installed MES source and
diffs it against the cache: new, removed
or changed tags get flagged, so the
* estimate: chars ÷ 3.9. Update-MesSkill.ps1 uses this formula, warns above 4,200, fails above 5,000
Why: SKILL.md is always read; references load only when the task needs them
9 encounter patterns: wreck, convoy, boss, drone…

g.text: WeaponCore guns left in AI shoot mode

svg.text: tags per profile type, from mes_tag_cache.json
RivalAI Action alone holds 22% of all tags; the top 6 hold 71%.
How much to trust each rule
Enforced by MES or the engine and checked against
the C# source. Break it and you get a crash, a
silent no-op, or a profile that won't load.
Field-tested on a live server, not pinned to a code
path. A starting point: re-check it after an MES
value type of each of the 1,744 tags
Over a quarter of all tags are plain true/false switches.
Source: github.com/GV-Server-Mods/se-dev-mes @ 89443e8, measured 2026-09-24. Counts via wc -l, grep, and a JSON parse of scripts/mes_tag_cache.json.
[HARD]/[SOFT] = label occurrences, with the two legend lines that define them excluded. Token figure is an estimate (chars ÷ 3.9), not a tokenizer count.
